in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Altab हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Altab is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'altas', meaning 'mountain'. In Hindu mythology, mountains are considered sacred abodes of gods and goddesses. Therefore, the name Altab is a fitting tribute to the divine. The name is a reminder of the strength and power of the divine and the reverence and devotion it inspires.
